name: Niko
blurb: a baikal seal who looks like he is about to cry at all times. your keepers call you a naughty, spoiled child, you wail until someone pays attention & you get in the middle of other seals' kisses. the internet says you were forced to eat cement when you were 6

name: Ponsuke
blurb: round, smiley & happy with the smallest things. a good meal, your tongue out & a nap is a perfect day. you are picky & you grunt at anyone who bothers you, but everyone loves you anyway. forever

name: Agu
blurb: 38 years old & still the most talented one in the room. you know every trick, you do them before anyone asks & you chirp for fish the second you see someone. calm, gentle & has never had any luck with the ladies

name: Hiyori
blurb: friendly, calm & a little sleepy until you hit the water, then nobody can catch you. you love a hat, you know every trick & you almost had a thought once. people mix you up with agu. kyoro never does

name: Yo-chan
blurb: round, sassy & famous for one squish. you snort at anyone who annoys you & slap your belly about it, especially when your kid is being loud. chill when left alone. a mom first

name: Katsunori
blurb: wrinkly, serious & patient, with the face of a stressed out dad. you agree with everything anyone says, you are loyal to your wife & you throw a fit in the shower. people scream when you come over. you are not scary

name: Tsuki
blurb: the baby of the family & the loudest seal in the building. you moo & whine until someone looks at you, you wake the old seals up from their naps & you play fight anyone who will let you. princess

name: Damn seal
blurb: a visual-technological nightmare. you flash, you shake & you crash the web. you have broken at least one computer & you would do it again
